description: This file defines a Router class for intercepting and handling network requests within a Playwright testing context, including request handling, route management, and fetch override logic.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: A class to manage request interception, handling, and route management in Playwright contexts.

methods.name: executeRequestHandlers
methods.description: Executes a list of request handlers for a given request, returning a response if any handler produces one.

methods.name: isMswRequestPassthrough
methods.description: Determines if a request should be passed through based on specific headers.

methods.name: globalFetch
methods.description: A wrapper around the global fetch function to handle MSW passthrough requests.

methods.name: route
methods.description: Adds a route to the Playwright context for request interception.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Registers request handlers to be used by the Router.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes all request handlers and unroutes the associated routes.

methods.name: _updateRequestHandlersRoute
methods.description: Updates the route registration based on current request handlers, managing fetch override.
